quality.review_scope: Scoped preparation and material-forming enzymatic Au growth from main/SI, with source-labeled series conditions and selected structural/optical evidence. Diagnostic calibration fits/selectivity and downstream cell handling are excluded; no complete-paper Reader.
missing_fields: No source full unit cell or measured atomic coordinates.
Record/sample IDs describe source contexts, not an exact independently identified physical batch.
Curve/control compositions and degree of Au reduction not assigned. Exact modification of precursor/substrate charge for each optimization setting not supplied.
conflicts: SI S2b caption saysQD-polymer-AAP, whereas main text discusses QD-polymer-ALP; polymer/solute identity wording unresolved.
SI S5 saysQD-polymer-ALP in PBS; main p.4 describes unstable response before ALP addition. Comparator enzyme status uncertain.
Main p.4 states leveling after~30min and chooses30min, while SI S7 graph visibly continues lower toward40min; retain source30min method without inventing an alternative measured plateau.
